description: Explicit model-reviewed role definition, not a completeness claim. Runtime uses dedicated field checks.

purpose.description: Bounded goal and necessary background without changing hard constraints.

io_scope.description: Explicit read-only sources and separately owned write locations. Subject to existing authorization.

items.description: Exact authorized absolute runtime path; data only, not an access grant. Resolve and check ownership before use.

callee_write_paths.description: Output locations owned by the callee; Lead only reads these.

items.description: Exact authorized absolute runtime path; data only, not an access grant. Resolve and check ownership before use.

lead_write_paths.description: Receipt/consolidation locations owned by the lead; disjoint from callee output ownership.

items.description: Exact authorized absolute runtime path; data only, not an access grant. Resolve and check ownership before use.

resources.description: Resolved required file/version/hash bindings. Missing mandatory bindings block dispatch; an empty list is not proof none are required.

items.description: A currently resolved file binding required by a quoted constraint; no substitution when unresolved.

constraint_ids.description: Existing hard-constraint IDs requiring this resource.

path.description: Exact authorized absolute runtime path; data only, not an access grant. Resolve and check ownership before use.

version.description: Exact required or observed version when applicable; do not infer or invent.

expected_sha256.description: Independently expected SHA256 of exact binary bytes. Only authorized explicit files are read, never executed.

hard_constraints.description: Every applicable upstream hard constraint, individually mapped to its verbatim source. Schema cannot prove no omission.

items.description: A hard instruction copied without paraphrase from one identified source. Completeness still requires comparison against the original.

constraint_id.description: Unique constraint ID, used unchanged by dispatch, preflight and delivery.

category.description: Classification only; never changes the quoted instruction.

applies_to.description: Who must satisfy this constraint; does not grant authority.

verification.description: What actual observation/receipt is required to establish compliance; not a self-attestation flag.

quote.description: Exact unique original substring, optionally within inclusive physical lines. No normalization or first-match fallback.

line_end.description: Inclusive line end >= start; requires line_start.

acceptance_criteria.description: Evidence-backed acceptance criteria referencing the same constraints.

items.description: Source-backed acceptance obligation, independent of whether a child claims success.

constraint_ids.description: Existing constraint IDs tested by this criterion.

text.description: Evidence and outcome required; retain uncertainty/failure treatment from source.

failure_policy.description: Report mismatches/unavailable prerequisites. Preserve evidence; no silent alternative runtime/tool/method or fabricated success.

delivery_requirements.description: Required raw evidence, identities and files as specified by the task; summaries do not replace required full artifacts.

role.description: Explicit semantic role, not inferred from Agent ID.
